name: Projects
description: Plan a project — a renovation, a move, a big purchase — in one place: a budget of estimated-versus-actual line items, a checklist with deadlines and milestones, photos of how it went, and a log of what you decided and why.

projects.sql: SELECT * FROM app_projects__projects ORDER BY (completed_at IS NULL) DESC, (target_date IS NULL), target_date, created_at LIMIT 100

budget.sql: SELECT b.* FROM app_projects__budget_items b JOIN app_projects__projects p ON p.id = b.project_id WHERE p.completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.project_id, b.sort_order, b.created_at LIMIT 500

checklist.sql: SELECT c.* FROM app_projects__checklist_items c JOIN app_projects__projects p ON p.id = c.project_id WHERE p.completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.project_id, c.sort_order, c.created_at LIMIT 500

notes.sql: SELECT n.* FROM app_projects__notes n JOIN app_projects__projects p ON p.id = n.project_id WHERE p.completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.project_id, n.created_at DESC LIMIT 200

completions.sql: SELECT x.* FROM app_projects__checklist_completions x JOIN app_projects__projects p ON p.id = x.project_id WHERE p.completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY x.project_id, x.done_at LIMIT 500

source.query: SELECT c.id AS id, c.title AS title, p.name AS subtitle, c.due_date AS when_at, c.assignee_id AS member_id, CASE WHEN x.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS done FROM app_projects__checklist_items c JOIN app_projects__projects p ON p.id = c.project_id LEFT JOIN app_projects__checklist_completions x ON x.item_id = c.id WHERE c.due_date = :today LIMIT 20
SELECT name AS title, NULLIF(description, '') AS subtitle, target_date AS at FROM app_projects__projects WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND target_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY target_date LIMIT 3

create_project.title: Start a project
create_project.description: Open a project when another app's event fires — a reserve-fund line item planned, a maintenance request that turned into real work — so the budget and the checklist have somewhere to live from day one.

suggested_automations.title: Turn a planned reserve-fund project into a real one
suggested_automations.description: When the reserve fund plans a project, open it here with its estimated cost already set as the budget — ready for line items, a checklist, and the quotes that come back.
